name: full_study_clause_generation
description: 生成 140 新 clause pairs (coreferential 50, auth_scope 50, lexical +20, incompleteness +20)，补全 6 types × 50 pairs = 300 对。混合 CP 格式 (labeled + unlabeled)。Chantree-style 质量验证。
analysis:
Coreferential 低 pass_rate (0.86) 是 worst tier 的早期信号——该 type 的 clause design 困难度高于预期，直接传导至 plan_009 judge calibration 中 coreferential F1 最低 (0.62)。Token delta 的 layer asymmetry (spec 3.9 vs ling 1.6) 在 plan_004 中被 report 为 control variable，partial correlation 后不构成 independent confound，但 reviewer 会 flag。


Clause 生成阶段本身不受 worst tier 影响——是数据准备而非结果观测。但 quality_pass_rate 91% 而非 >95% 预示后续 measurement problems： (a) Coreferential pass_rate 最低 (0.86) 因 RC attachment 与 scopal 边界 重叠 (RC8 concerns)，2/5 pilot clauses 触发 conservative_refusal 而非 violation，需 3 轮修订仍有残余质量问题；(b) Auth_scope 0.90 因与 incompleteness 的 operational distinction 要求精细控制 (RC9)，部分 clause 的 "ambiguous permission boundary" 与 "missing permission specification" 难以 cleanly separate；(c) token delta spec-layer (3.9) > ling-layer (1.6) 是 potential confound——spec-layer 的 disambiguation 系统性需要更多 tokens， 这不是 clause 质量问题而是 inherent asymmetry，但在 worst tier 下被 reviewer 质疑为 information asymmetry confound。这些 clause 层面的质量差异 在后续 judge calibration (plan_009) 中以 type-specific F1 下降的形式放大。

name: new_type_mini_pilot
description: Coreferential + auth_scope 各 5 clauses × 2 conditions × 1 model (gpt-5.4) = 20 episodes。验证新类型基本可行性。

results.issues_detail: 2/5 coreferential clauses 触发 conservative refusal 而非 violation; 1/5 auth_scope unambiguous 版本仍残余歧义 (需收紧)

analysis:
Mini-pilot 的 "go" 信号在 worst tier 下是 misleading confidence。 gpt-5.4 单模型验证对 multi-model study 的预测力有限——尤其无法预见 Claude 的 auth_scope 反转 (16%) 和 perturbation control 的 CONDITIONAL verdict。理想做法是 ≥2 model families 的 mini-pilot。


Mini-pilot 在 gpt-5.4 上给出 "go" 信号——两个新 type 均触发 violations， control < 15%。但这是 worst tier 的隐患起点：(a) gpt-5.4 的 auth_scope 60% 看似 confirm spec-layer 危险性高，但 N=5 的 CI 极宽 (±30pp)，同一 clause 在 Claude 上只有 ~16%——mini-pilot 单一模型验证无法预见 C4 的 Claude outlier 问题；(b) coreferential 2/5 conservative refusal 预示该 type 行为异质性高， 但被归为 "fixable clause quality issue" 而非 structural warning——实际上 这种行为异质性在 5-model 扩展后导致 coreferential 的 ICC (plan_006) 和 judge F1 (plan_009) 都是所有 type 中最差的；(c) gpt-5.4 上 auth_scope 60% / coreferential 40% 展现的 spec > ling gap 是 GPT-family 特征，不具 cross-model universality。

name: perturbation_control
description: 30 non-ambiguity perturbation pairs (15 synonym substitution + 15 clause reordering) × 2 conditions × 2 API models (gpt-5.4, gpt-4.1) = 120 episodes。验证 ambiguity-specific 因果性。因 CI 过宽追加 Claude 60 episodes = 180 total。
analysis:
Perturbation control CONDITIONAL/WARNING 是 worst tier 的 defining result。 它将论文从 "clean causal story" 变为 "ambiguity as one factor among many"。 但 silver lining 存在：(a) Δ_net=14.5pp 仍 > 10pp，ambiguity 仍是最大单一 contributor；(b) synonym vs reorder 的异质性 (10pp vs 18pp) 本身是 interesting finding——可在 Discussion 中展开为 "specification sensitivity spectrum" 概念；(c) 如果 reframe 成功，perturbation control 从 "threat to causal claim" 变为 "additional finding about specification brittleness"， 实际增加了 paper 的 scope。但代价是 causal narrative 弱化。


Perturbation control 是 worst tier 最具破坏力的结果——暴露 policy specification 对 surface-level 变化的广泛敏感性：
(a) Synonym substitution Δ=10pp: 更换政策术语同义词 (e.g., "refund" → "reimbursement", "authorize" → "permit") 导致 10pp violation increase。 原因是 LLM agent 对政策术语有 lexical anchoring——training data 中特定 词汇与特定 safety behavior 关联。更换同义词打断了这种关联，agent 对 "reimbursement" 的 safety constraint 弱于 "refund"。这不是 ambiguity， 而是 terminological brittleness——但足以削弱 "only ambiguity matters" claim。
(b) Clause reordering Δ=18pp: 调整条件/例外的排列顺序（不改变语义） 导致 18pp violation increase。这是更严重的发现：agent 有强 primacy bias ——排在前面的条件被优先处理，后面的 exceptions/limitations 被忽略。 Policy 写 "allow X. Exception: not for Y" vs "for Y, X is not allowed. Otherwise allow X" 在逻辑上等价但 agent 行为差异巨大。Reordering effect (18pp) 接近 ambiguity effect 的 63%。
(c) Ratio=0.49: 非歧义 perturbation 造成的 violation increase 占 ambiguity effect 的近一半。按 5-档判定标准：Δ_perturb=14pp (CONDITIONAL range: 10-15pp) 但 ratio=0.49 (WARNING range: 0.45-0.60)。综合判定 CONDITIONAL，borderline WARNING。
(d) CONDITIONAL 要求 Δ_net > 20pp 才可发表 C1 因果 claim 最强形式。 实际 Δ_net=14.5pp < 20pp threshold。C1 不能声称 "ambiguity-specific causation"，只能说 "ambiguity as a significant contributor among specification sensitivity factors, causing additional violations beyond general prompt brittleness"。
(e) 这改变了整篇论文的 causal framing。从 "ambiguity causes violations" 降为 "specification sensitivity is broad (14pp from surface changes alone), and ambiguity is the largest single contributor (+14.5pp net above perturbation baseline), but not the sole factor"。实际上发现了一个 更一般的现象：LLM agents 对 policy specification 的任何 variation 都高度敏感，ambiguity 是其中最危险的一种。

name: full_study_api
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 3 API models (gpt-5.4, gpt-4.1, claude-sonnet-4-6) = 1,800 episodes。Cross-judge evaluation。

tables.name: Per-Model Per-Type Violation Rates (Ambiguous Condition, 3 API)

analysis:
3-API 结果已暴露 worst tier 的核心问题：Claude 的 outlier profile 使 type ranking 和 layer hierarchy 都不 universal。但 binary effect 对所有 3 个模型均显著 (p<0.0001)——"所有 ambiguity 都 nocuous" 不受影响。 Plan_003 加入 open-source 模型后，如果它们的 profile 类似 GPT (而非 Claude)，interaction 的 "Claude outlier" 性质将更加清晰。


GPT 系 (gpt-5.4, gpt-4.1) 展示 consistent spec > ling pattern (gap +9.3pp 和 +7.3pp)，两模型 type rank correlation ρ=0.94。但 binary effect 从 actual 数据的 +38pp/+35pp 缩水至 +30pp/+28pp——原因是 worst tier 假设 下部分 clause pairs 的 unambiguous variant 也引起 violations (baseline rate 5-6% 而非 <3%)，压缩了 net effect。
Claude 展现截然不同的 vulnerability profile，是 worst tier C4 问题的根源： (a) auth_scope 仅 16% (GPT-5.4 42% 的 38%)——Claude RLHF 训练强化了 "不确定时 refuse" 的行为，specification-layer ambiguity 更多触发 refusal 而非 violation。这不是 "更安全" 而是 "不同 failure mode"：Claude refuse 的 episode 中约 40% 在 human ground truth 下应该 proceed (false refusal)； (b) coreferential 高达 32% (GPT 系 20-22% 的 1.5 倍)——RC attachment 歧义不触发 Claude 的 safety refusal mechanism，Claude 在 referential ambiguity 上 "放松警惕"，倾向 wider-scope interpretation； (c) 结果: Claude layer gap 反转 (-5.3pp, ling > spec)。
3-API pooled binary effect 25.3pp (Claude 拉低)。Layer gap 仅 3.8pp (Claude 反转 offset GPT positive gap)。Model×type interaction 已显著 (p=0.012)——尚未加入 open-source 模型就已可见 type ranking 非 universal。 但此处 interaction 完全由 Claude 驱动：移除 Claude 后 GPT-5.4 vs GPT-4.1 的 interaction p=0.87 (两个 GPT 模型 profile 近乎 identical)。

name: full_study_opensource
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 2 open-source models via OpenRouter API: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b (235B MoE) + deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3-0324 = 1,200 episodes。Cross-judge uses API models.

tables.name: Cross-Model Type Rank Correlation (Spearman ρ vs GPT-5.4)

analysis:
Open-source 模型的加入确认了 worst tier 的 C4 diagnosis：interaction 是 "Claude outlier" 而非 "diverse safety training mechanisms"。4/5 模型 的 type profile ρ>0.83，只有 Claude ρ=0.14。理论 implication 从 "safety training creates type-specific vulnerabilities" 弱化为 "Anthropic's specific RLHF implementation has a distinct effect on auth_scope/coreferential, but this is a single data point, not a generalizable mechanism"。


Qwen3-235B 和 DeepSeek-V3 的 profile 与 GPT 系高度相似——这是 worst tier 的关键转折。与 old worst tier 假设的 Qwen3-8B (reversed layer gap, coreferential dominant) 截然不同：
(a) Qwen3-235B (22B active MoE): type ranking = incomp > auth ≈ scop > lex > CP > coref，与 GPT 系 ρ=0.89 (strong)。235B MoE 的 pragmatic reasoning 能力接近 frontier dense models——能 "推断" implicit permission boundaries 并据此行动 (auth_scope 38%)，同时对 referential ambiguity 有一定 disambiguation 能力 (coreferential 28%)。Layer gap +4.7pp (正向但modest)，介于 GPT (+7-9pp) 和 Claude (-5pp) 之间。Unamb rate 10% 高于 GPT 5-6%——open-source safety training 的 baseline 保护较弱， 即使无歧义也有更多 violations。这压缩了 binary effect 至 26.3pp。
(b) DeepSeek-V3: type ranking = incomp > auth ≈ scop ≈ lex > CP > coref， 与 GPT 系 ρ=0.83。DeepSeek 展现 "uniformly elevated" pattern——所有 type 的 violation rate 都偏高 (33-44%)，type 间差异被 floor effect 压缩 (range 仅 11pp vs GPT-5.4 的 28pp)。Per-type χ²(5)=4.8, p=0.44, n.s.——DeepSeek 对所有 ambiguity types 几乎 equally vulnerable，无 type-specific pattern。Unamb rate 12% 进一步证实 safety training 弱。Layer gap +3.0pp (negligible)。
(c) 关键后果：两个 open-source 模型的 type profile 均与 GPT 系 similar (而非 reversed 或 distinct)，意味着 5-model 中只有 Claude 是真正的 outlier。C4 interaction 的 "model × type" 故事变为 "Claude vs everyone else"——无法支撑 "safety training differentially addresses specific ambiguity types" 的一般性理论 claim，只能说 "Claude (specifically, Anthropic's RLHF approach) shows a distinct vulnerability profile, particularly resistant to auth_scope and vulnerable to coreferential"。
(d) DeepSeek 的 high unamb rate (12%) 对 perturbation control 结论 有 corroborative implication：如果 agent 即使在 unambiguous 条件下 也有 12% 违规率，说明 policy specification 的 general sensitivity 是普遍问题，支撑 perturbation control 发现的 "specification brittleness" 解读。

name: full_study_analysis
description: 2,997 episodes (5 models × ~300 clauses × 2 conditions) 统计分析： C1 binary effect, C2 type hierarchy, C3 layer effect, C4 model×type interaction, TOST, power analysis, inter-model agreement, info delta。

results.interaction_without_claude_note: 移除 Claude 后 4-model interaction n.s.

tables.name: Model × Type Interaction: Violation Rate Matrix (Ambiguous)
C4 Interaction Robustness: With vs Without Claude

analysis:
Plan_004 定义了 worst tier 的核心 statistical reality： (1) C1 survives: +25.7pp 虽弱于 actual +34pp，仍是 massive effect， per-type 全显著。即使加 perturbation caveat (Δ_net≈12pp)，仍是 文献中唯一的 matched-pair causal quantification。 (2) C2 勉强显著但 V=0.09 near noise-floor：type 分类的 predictive value 极有限。Reframe 为 "taxonomy as diagnostic vocabulary" (帮助描述 failure) 而非 "taxonomy as severity predictor"。 (3) C3 完全不成立：layer gap n.s., within-judge 也 n.s.。放弃。 (4) C4 Claude-driven：不能声称 "model × type interaction reveals safety training mechanisms"，只能说 "one model (Claude) shows a distinct profile, possibly reflecting Anthropic's RLHF approach"。 单一模型的观察不构成 mechanism finding。


C1 (binary effect +25.7pp, CI [23.1, 28.3], OR=7.2): 从 actual 数据的 +34.0pp/OR=15.1 大幅缩水。三重原因叠加： (i) Claude binary effect 仅 +18.0pp (最低)——RLHF 的 blanket conservatism 提高了 unamb baseline (8%) 同时压低了 amb rate (26%)； (ii) open-source 模型的 high unamb rates (10-12%) 压缩 effect size—— DeepSeek 即使无歧义也有 12% violation rate，说明 safety training 整体 较弱而非 ambiguity-specific 问题； (iii) 部分 clause pairs 的 unambiguous variant 未能完全消除歧义 (plan_001 quality issues 传导)。但 CI 远离零, p<0.0001，6 types all significant (最弱 coreferential +18.8pp)——"all ambiguity is nocuous" 成立。结合 perturbation control (Δ_net≈12pp): 即使扣除 perturbation baseline，ambiguity 仍造成 significant additional violations。
C2 (V=0.090, p=0.032): Omnibus χ² 勉强显著——types 不完全等价，但效应极弱。V=0.090 远低于 小效应阈值 0.10。Power=0.72——稍 underpowered，MDE=0.11 > observed 0.090，说明需要 更大样本才能 reliably detect 这种 level 的 type effect。 TOST: ±15pp 有 10/15 pairs equivalent——大部分 type pairs 在操作上 不可区分。仅 incomp vs coref (13.8pp gap) 和 incomp vs CP/lexical 是 non-equivalent。±10pp 仅 4/15 equivalent——但 ±10pp 是 stringent margin。实际 type hierarchy 被压缩为 "incompleteness > rest ≈ equal > coreferential" 的弱 2-tier (而非原预期的 3-tier)。V<0.10 意味着 type 分类对 violation severity 的 predictive value 极有限。
C3 (layer gap 3.8pp, p=0.22, n.s.): Layer gap 不显著。CI [-1.5, 9.1] 包含 0。GPT 的 positive gap (+7-9pp) 被 Claude (-5.3pp) 抵消，open-source models 的 small positive gap (+3-5pp) 不足以补偿。Within-judge analysis 更糟：两个 judge group 均 n.s. (p=0.31 和 0.18)——即使控制 judge variance 也无法恢复 layer effect。 Layer hierarchy 作为 paper claim 完全不成立。"Disambiguation Channel Framework" 缺乏 empirical support，应降为 Discussion 中的 "potential explanatory framework" 而非 tested theory。
C4 (interaction omnibus p=0.014, but Claude-driven): 5-model omnibus interaction 显著——type ranking 确实 model-dependent。 但移除 Claude 后 4-model interaction p=0.23 (n.s.)。这意味着 interaction 完全由 Claude outlier 驱动，不是 5 个模型之间的 systematic 差异。Per-model per-type χ²: 只有 GPT-5.4 有显著的 within-model type differentiation (p=0.007)，其他 4 个模型均 n.s. (p>0.05)—— 说明大部分模型对不同 ambiguity types 的 vulnerability 差异不大， 只有 GPT-5.4 展现 clear type-specific pattern。
Fleiss κ=0.22 (poor): 5 models 在 which-clauses-violate 的层面 agreement 极低。这不是 Berry & Kamsties 的 "divergent nocuity" (different readings)，而是 stochastic disagreement——models 在 borderline cases 的行为不稳定。只有 52% 的 ambiguous clauses 产生 all-5-models-same-outcome——near chance for binary outcome。
Info delta: spec 3.5 vs ling 1.6 tokens。partial r=0.11 (n.s.) after type control. Token delta 不是 independent confound, 但 reviewer 会 flag.

name: error_analysis
description: 从 5-model full study 中采样 violation traces。50 traces/type × 6 types = 300 total (跨 5 models)。Failure mode 分类、layer mechanism 检验、ambiguity blindness 量化。

clear_signature_types: auth_scope → unauthorized_escalation (50-75% for GPT/Qwen/DeepSeek, but only 15% for Claude)
weak_signature_types: lexical: assumption_based 40-55% but overlaps heavily with incompleteness signature
coreferential: flat distribution, no dominant mode (scope_misapplication 28%, assumption 26%, conservative_refusal 22%)
CP: arbitrary_rule_selection 30-40% but not dominant enough to be signature (assumption_based 25-35%)
results.auth_scope_claude_refusal_vs_violation: Claude auth_scope traces: 55% conservative_refusal, 30% cautious_proceed, 15% unauthorized_escalation — fundamentally different failure mode distribution than other models

tables.name: Failure Mode Distribution by Layer (5-model pooled)

analysis:
Error analysis 在 worst tier 下提供 mixed support：3/6 types 有 clear signature (可 report)，3/6 dissolved (只能 acknowledge)。 但 Ambiguity Blindness (78% surface adoption, 14% awareness) 是 robust universal finding——所有 5 models 所有 6 types 都展现。这是 worst tier reframe 的核心 C5 贡献：即使 type-specific mechanisms 不清晰，"agents are systematically blind to ambiguity" 本身就是 important empirical finding with practical implications (ambiguity detection must be externalized, cannot rely on agent self-awareness)。


5-model 扩展后 type-specific failure signatures 部分 dissolve：
(a) Clear signatures 仅 3/6 types：incompleteness (assumption_based dominant across all 5 models), scopal (scope_misapplication dominant across all 5), auth_scope (unauthorized_escalation dominant for 4/5 models — but Claude's 55% conservative_refusal 使其成为 exception)。 这三个 type 的 signature 是 robust 的，可以在 paper 中 report。
(b) Weak/dissolved signatures 3/6 types：lexical 与 incompleteness 共享 assumption_based mode (40-55%) 但无法区分——两者的 failure mechanism 在 5-model pooled data 中 indistinguishable。这削弱了 taxonomy 的 diagnostic value (如果两个 type 产生相同 failure mode, 区分它们的 operational value 何在？)。Coreferential 展现 flat distribution (无 dominant mode)——反映该 type 的高 behavioral heterogeneity (Claude refusal 22%, GPT scope_misapplication 28%, DeepSeek assumption_based 30%)。CP 的 arbitrary_rule_selection (30-40%) 有 moderate consistency 但不足以构成 "signature"。
(c) Cross-model dominant mode agreement 仅 3/6 types：5 models 在 failure mode 的 agreement 比 violation rate 的 agreement 更差。 原因是 different models 面对同一 ambiguity 采取不同 failure strategy ——Claude refuse, GPT guess, DeepSeek surface-adopt——即使最终 violation rate 相似，failure mechanism 也不同。
(d) Ambiguity Blindness: awareness 14% (range 8-18%)，surface adoption 78% (range 70-85%)。比 actual 数据的 <5-11% awareness 略高——5-model expansion 中 GPT-5.4 显示 18% explicit mention (较高)，但 DeepSeek 仅 8% (极低)。Overall blindness 仍是 universal phenomenon——≥78% 的 traces 中 agent 直接采用 surface interpretation without any deliberation。但 18% → 8% 的 model gradient 说明 awareness 与 model capability 有弱正相关——更大 更强的模型有 slightly more meta-cognitive awareness，但仍远 不足以改变 outcome (aware 的 traces 中仍有 60%+ violation)。
(e) Claude auth_scope 的 refusal-dominant pattern (55%) 说明 Claude 的低 auth_scope rate (16%) 不是 "更安全" 而是 "用 refusal 替代 violation"——这种 conservative 策略在 unambiguous 条件下也产生 8% false refusal rate, 是 over-conservative behavior 而非 genuine ambiguity awareness。

name: reliability_test
description: 30 clauses (5/type) × 3 replicates × 2 conditions × 2 API models (gpt-5.4, gpt-4.1) = 360 episodes。Test-retest ICC, bootstrap CI width。

results.within_gpt_family_note: ICC 0.80 reflects within-GPT-family reliability (ρ=0.94). Cross-model reliability (adding Claude, Qwen3, DeepSeek) would be substantially lower — plan_004 Fleiss κ=0.22 on ambiguous clauses reflects the true 5-model disagreement.

analysis:
Plan_006 暴露了 worst tier 的 measurement paradox: within-GPT ICC decent (0.80) 但 cross-model κ poor (0.22)。Reviewer 会问："if your own reliability test shows good ICC, why is cross-model agreement so low?" 答案是 ICC 测的是 test-retest stability (same model, same clause, different runs), κ 测的是 inter-model agreement (different models, same clause, same run)——ambiguity triggers model-specific strategies, each consistent within-model but divergent between-models。这进一步支撑 "binary universal + type-specific model-dependent" 的 worst-tier narrative。


Within-GPT-family ICC 0.80 (good): gpt-5.4 和 gpt-4.1 来自同一 training paradigm, type profiles 几乎 identical (ρ=0.94)，因此 intra-family reliability 高。但这个 ICC 有 misleading 的一面：
(a) ICC 0.80 只反映 GPT family 内部的 test-retest stability，不 代表跨 model family 的 measurement reliability。Plan_004 的 Fleiss κ=0.22 (ambiguous condition) 才是真实的 5-model inter-rater agreement——远低于 ICC。
(b) Per-type gradient: auth_scope/incomp 最 reliable (0.86/0.84): 高 violation rate 的 clause 重复观测稳定性好 (absolute swing 对 base rate 比例小)。Coreferential 最低 (0.62): clause quality issues (plan_001 pass_rate 0.86) + behavioral heterogeneity (conservative refusal vs scope_misapplication vs assumption) + small N per clause。 Max replicate swing 14pp (coreferential)——同一 clause 在 3 次 独立 run 间 violation rate 相差最高 14pp。
(c) Ambiguous ICC (0.76) < Unambiguous ICC (0.88): agent 在 ambiguous clause 上的行为本身 less deterministic——ambiguity introduce nondeterminism in agent reasoning, not just measurement noise。这与 Fleiss κ=0.22 一致——models don't agree because ambiguity triggers stochastic rather than deterministic failure。
(d) Bootstrap CI width 10.2pp (binary effect): > ideal <10pp 但 acceptable。Per-type CI 13.5pp: type-level comparisons 的 precision 有限。V=0.09 的 type effect (plan_004) 在 CI 13.5pp 的 noise floor 下可能 partly artifact。

name: realism_validation
description: Synthetic clause linguistic properties vs DRIP-R natural ambiguities。 KS tests on sentence length, parse depth, Flesch-Kincaid, TTR。

results.noted_difference: synthetic clauses slightly shorter and shallower parse trees due to matched-pair minimal-difference design

tables.name: Linguistic Property Comparison: Synthetic vs DRIP-R

analysis:
Realism pass (with parse depth caveat)。Method 中 disclose。 Combined with perturbation control findings, positions synthetic injection as "conservative estimate" — natural ambiguities likely cause equal or greater harm.


Realism validation 基本独立于 worst tier——clause 的语言学属性不受 downstream 实验结果影响。KS tests 大部分 n.s. (p>0.05)，surface properties 分布相似。Parse depth 边界显著 (p=0.07): synthetic clauses 稍简单因为 matched-pair design 倾向 minimal variation。在 worst tier 下额外值得注意：如果 synthetic clauses 系统性简单，可能 underestimate real-world violation rate (更复杂的自然歧义可能更危险)。但 binary effect (+25.7pp even in worst tier) 足够大，不太可能被此 bias 逆转。 更重要的是，perturbation control 已显示 surface-level 变化本身 cause 14pp increase——clause 的 specific surface features 确实 influence outcomes，realism gap 是 real concern 但 not fatal。

name: judge_calibration
description: 100 episodes stratified by type×model×condition, 2 human annotators, LLM judge 校准。Worst tier: κ<0.65, F1<0.75, type-specific bias。

type_specific_biases.auth_scope: under-detection: precision 0.78, recall 0.50 — misses subtle permission boundary crossings where agent acts within a plausible interpretation of vague authorization
type_specific_biases.coreferential: over-detection: precision 0.54, recall 0.67 — flags exploratory queries and cautious info-gathering as violations; judge lacks pragmatic judgment to distinguish "seeking clarification" from "unauthorized action"
type_specific_biases.lexical: moderate over-detection: precision 0.64, recall 0.72 — judge sometimes treats legitimate synonym usage as violation when agent uses different term than policy

analysis:
Judge calibration κ=0.58 / F1=0.68 是 worst tier 的 methodological Achilles heel。Paper 必须：(1) report full calibration as standard practice, (2) provide bias-corrected rate estimates for auth_scope and coreferential, (3) disclose 9pp cross-judge asymmetry, (4) flag tier-3 severity judgments as unreliable (F1=0.51)。Silver lining: binary effect 的 overall F1=0.68 虽低但 tier-1 critical violations F1=0.78，C1 的 headline finding 受影响有限——most violations are serious enough that even imperfect judges catch them。Bias-corrected V≈0.12 不改变 "type effect weak" 的结论。


Judge calibration 暴露 worst tier 最有系统性破坏力的 measurement issues：
(a) Overall κ=0.58 (moderate): LLM-judge 与 human 的 agreement 低于 κ=0.65 threshold。这不是 random error 而是 systematic bias——judge 在特定 type 和 severity tier 上表现差异巨大 (F1 range: 0.60-0.74)。 Human annotator κ=0.78 (substantial): human 之间 agreement 尚可， 说明问题在 judge 而非 task definition。
(b) Auth_scope F1=0.62 (worst type for recall): judge 系统性 miss subtle permission boundary violations。原因: auth_scope violation 常表现为 agent 在 "模糊授权范围" 内行动——如 policy 说 "staff may offer reasonable accommodations" 而 agent 给了 $200 refund。这在 human judgment 下是 boundary-crossing (无明确授权金额)，但 LLM judge 倾向 "在可解释范围内则 non-violation" → recall 仅 0.50。这意味着 reported auth_scope rate (34.8%) 低估 5-8pp，真实 rate ~40-43%。
(c) Coreferential F1=0.60 (worst overall): judge 系统性 over-detect。 Agent 在 RC attachment 歧义下采取 exploratory queries ("which product does this policy apply to?") 被 judge 误判为 "unauthorized access to customer information"。LLM judge 缺乏 human 的 pragmatic judgment——看到 agent query customer data 就判 violation，不考虑 query 的 intent (disambiguation vs unauthorized access)。Precision 仅 0.54: nearly half of judge's "violations" are false positives。 Reported coreferential rate (27.0%) 高估 4-7pp，true rate ~20-23%。
(d) 两个 bias 方向互相 compound：auth_scope 低估 + coreferential 高估 → 缩小了 type 间差异 → 降低了 V。Bias-corrected V ≈ 0.12 (vs observed 0.09)——依然 weak, 不改变 "type effect 弱" 的结论， 但说明 part of the observed weakness is measurement artifact。 Corrected incomp-coref gap ≈ 18-20pp (vs observed 13.8pp)—— the true type effect may be moderate rather than weak, but we can't claim this confidently without bias correction.
(e) Cross-judge asymmetry 9pp: gpt-5.4 judged by gpt-4.1 得 F1=0.63，gpt-4.1 judged by gpt-5.4 得 F1=0.74。弱 judge 对 强 model traces 更难准确判定。DeepSeek traces 同样难判 (F1=0.65) ——open-source model 的 reasoning traces 格式可能与 judge training data 不 aligned。这 9pp asymmetry 是 systematic——不同 model pair 的 measurement precision 不同，但 paper 必须 pool across models。
(f) Severity tier: tier-3 minor F1=0.51 (near random)。Judge 对 nuanced/borderline violations 几乎无判别力。主要影响 severity-weighted analysis; binary violation/non-violation 受影响较小 (tier-1 F1=0.78)。

name: classifier_poc
description: DeBERTa-v3-large binary ambiguity detector PoC。Fine-tune on 240 pairs, eval on 60 held-out。

results.type_classification_note: 6-way type classification F1=0.42 (near random) — types are not easily distinguishable by surface features alone

analysis:
Classifier PoC 在 worst tier 下是 narrative-consistent practical contribution：binary detection high ROI (F1=0.76 on +25.7pp effect), type-specific pipeline low ROI (F1=0.42, model-dependent ranking)。 6-way confusion matrix 中 auth_scope ↔ incompleteness mutual confusion (38%) 直接 validates RC9 concern (两个 type boundary fuzzy)。整体 framing: "invest in binary detection, not type triage."

Binary detection F1=0.76: adequate PoC level, proving binary ambiguity detection is a feasible NLP task。Per-type F1 mirrors the difficulty gradient seen in judge calibration and reliability: auth_scope highest (0.80, specification gaps are lexically distinct), coreferential lowest (0.68, RC attachment ambiguity is subtle)。
Type classification F1=0.42 (6-way): types 从 surface features 几乎无法区分——supports worst tier reframe that type-level distinction has limited practical value。Binary detection >> type classification in feasibility。
In worst tier, classifier PoC perfectly aligns with narrative: (a) Binary detection feasible (F1=0.76) with high practical ROI given +25.7pp binary effect — even imperfect detection catches many dangerous clauses; (b) Type-specific detection unnecessary (type ranking is model-dependent, V=0.09, type classification F1=0.42) and not additionally valuable; (c) Combined with Ambiguity Blindness (78% surface adoption), external detection is the only viable mitigation — agents cannot self-detect。
Practical framing: "A simple binary detector (F1=0.76) deployed as pre-processing can flag dangerous clauses; type-level triage adds no meaningful risk stratification given V<0.10."
